headline: Congress named a post office in Hilliard, Ohio after two military veterans and all veterans.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 4000 Leap Road in Hilliard, Ohio. The new name honors Master Sergeant Shawn T. Hannon, Master Sergeant Jeffrey J. Rieck, and veterans in general. It is a naming measure and does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2014.
